## Fixes

- **Windows: the capture overlay lines up with the screen again.** If Windows moved or maximized the hidden overlay (after sleep or a display change), the frozen screen showed up shifted down with a black band on top. KeepShot now puts it back in place before every capture.
- **Linux: Escape closes the capture right away.** The overlay now gets keyboard focus when opened from a desktop shortcut, so you no longer have to click the screen first.
